def final_grade(items: Iterable[GradedItem]) -> Optional[float]:
    """Return the weighted average score (0..20) rounded to 2 decimals.

    Items whose score is None are ignored. Returns None if nothing is graded.
    """
    # Convert to list to allow multiple passes
    items = list(items)
    # Compute weighted sum of scores, ignoring items with no score
    total = sum(item.weight * item.score for item in items if item.score is not None)
    # Sum of weights for items that have a score
    weight_sum = sum(item.weight for item in items if item.score is not None)
    # If no graded items, return None
    if weight_sum == 0:
        return None
    # Normalized weighted average
    return round(total / weight_sum, 2)
